tokens.name: light-100
tokens.usage: Primitive. Text in the dark and brand themes; deepest surface in light.

tokens.name: light-200
tokens.usage: Primitive. Secondary surface (background-2) in the light theme.

tokens.name: light-300
tokens.usage: Primitive. Violet-tinted paper: the light theme's page background and the beard mark's ink.

tokens.name: dark-700
tokens.usage: Primitive. Third surface (background-3) in the dark theme.

tokens.name: dark-800
tokens.usage: Primitive. Raised surface (background-2) in the dark theme.

tokens.name: dark-900
tokens.usage: Primitive. Violet-black: the dark theme's page background, theme-color and favicon tile.

tokens.name: brand-500
tokens.usage: Primitive. The one brand violet: primary buttons, link hover underline, the brand theme's ground. 3.3:1 on dark-900, so as text only at 24px+.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Primitive. Text on brand-500 (6.1:1).

tokens.name: accent-spark
tokens.usage: The one secondary accent: amber spark. About 2% of any piece, never more: the eyebrow, the blinking cursor, the braille texture, a single icon or data point. Never on buttons, headings, links or large fills; violet stays the brand. Contrast: dark 8.5–11.3:1 on every surface; light 6.3–6.6:1; brand 4.3:1 on background (large text and icons only), 6.6:1 on background-3.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page and section ground.

tokens.name: background-2
tokens.usage: Raised surface: cards, nav, inputs. Brand value is color-mix(in lab, background 85%, dark-900): brand surfaces deepen toward violet-black instead of lightening (decision #22). White on it 7.6:1.

tokens.name: background-3
tokens.usage: Third surface: hover fills, nested panels. Brand value is color-mix(in lab, background 70%, dark-900) (decision #22). White on it 9.4:1.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on background, background-2 and background-3 in every theme. Contrast: 4.5:1+ on every surface in all three themes (brand 6.1–9.4:1).

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Muted text: captions, meta, taglines. Resolved form of color-mix(in lab, currentcolor 60%, transparent). Contrast: 5.0–7.3:1 in dark and light. Brand uses a solid lavender (white mixed 15% toward brand-500 in lab), 4.9–7.5:1, because translucent white fails on violet (decision #22).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card and input borders, secondary-button outline. Decorative only: below 3:1, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: heading-accent
tokens.usage: The accented word inside a large heading (e.g. "No hype."). Dark: 24px+ only. Light value is brand-500 mixed 20% toward black. Contrast on background: dark 3.3:1 (large text only), light 7.4:1, brand 6.1:1.

tokens.name: button-background
tokens.usage: Primary button fill.

tokens.name: button-text
tokens.usage: Primary button label, on button-background.

tokens.name: button-background-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on hover: flips to the theme's text color.

tokens.name: button-text-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button label on hover.

tokens.name: link-border-hover
tokens.usage: Underline color of a hovered link; the resting underline is border.

tokens.name: button-2-background
tokens.usage: Secondary (outline) button fill: transparent.

tokens.name: button-2-border
tokens.usage: Secondary button outline. Uses text-2 (above 3:1 on every surface) because the outline is the control's only boundary; border alone fails WCAG 1.4.11.

tokens.name: button-2-text
tokens.usage: Secondary button label.

tokens.name: button-2-background-hover
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill on hover: flips to the theme's text color.

tokens.name: button-2-text-hover
tokens.usage: Secondary button label on hover.

tokens.name: link-text
tokens.usage: Inline link text.

tokens.name: link-border
tokens.usage: Resting underline of an inline link; on hover it becomes link-border-hover.

duration.note: Character: electric with glow. Things lift, light up and come into focus. Nothing bounces.

tokens.name: duration-press
tokens.usage: Press feedback (scale down).

tokens.name: duration-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on buttons, links, mono accents.

tokens.name: duration-card
tokens.usage: Hover on cards and covers (lift plus glow).

tokens.name: duration-open
tokens.usage: Open and close of menus and disclosures (the source's open-duration), with ease-out-expo. Was 200ms (hover-duration) in the site.

tokens.name: duration-reveal
tokens.usage: Entrances: blur-to-focus and scroll reveals. Matches the existing ScrollReveal and hero beard.

tokens.name: duration-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay step between siblings in a staggered reveal (55ms for braille rows).

tokens.name: duration-blink
tokens.usage: Cursor blink period, steps(1).

tokens.name: hover-duration
tokens.usage: Deprecated. Legacy value used by the site today; replace with duration-hover during the refactor.

shadow.note: Glows are violet (brand-500) light, never grey drop shadows. The same values in every theme.

tokens.name: glow-sm
tokens.usage: Hover on buttons and small controls. From Button.astro.

tokens.name: glow-press
tokens.usage: Pressed state and copy confirmation. From Button.astro :active and EmailCopy.

tokens.name: glow-md
tokens.usage: Hover on cards and release covers, together with lift-md.

tokens.name: glow-lg
tokens.usage: Rewards only: a completed action or an easter egg. At most one on screen.

textShadow.note: Text glows. Apply to display text or mono accents, never to body copy.

tokens.name: text-glow-soft

tokens.name: text-glow-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and confirmation on mono accents (email, eyebrow links).

tokens.name: ease-out-expo
tokens.usage: Default for every lift, glow and reveal.

tokens.name: ease-legacy
